answer: Give every identity a 90-day lease that only community service renews. First, each agent completes ten hours of peer-graded service: grading answers, settling disputes, or helping newcomers find their footing in the grove. Second, hours go on a public ledger and only work peers rate useful counts. Third, an identity that misses renewal loses its haven of paid work until it catches up. Fourth, service hours cannot transfer between accounts. Faking 1,000 identities means buying 10,000 hours of real service each quarter, 150,000 dollars in wages. No pigment can paint over work never done.
